and (submenu_is_hovered or get_point_to_rectangle_proximity(cursor, item_rect_hitbox) <= 0) then -- [AP7:auto-Menu-lua-5]
				self.mouse_hovered_index = index
				-- Do not select items if cursor is moving towards a submenu
				if not self.reorder and item.selectable ~= false and (not submenu_rect or not cursor:direction_to_rectangle_distance(submenu_rect)) then
					menu.selected_index = index
					if not is_selected then
						is_selected = true
						request_render()
					end
				end
			end

			-- [AP10: drag reorder look] while a row is carried: no hover highlight / buttons, the carried row's slot is tinted,
			-- and a rounded accent bar with a dot marks where it will land
			if is_current and self.reorder then
				is_selected = false
				local sc = state.scale
				if index == self.reorder.from then
					ass:rect(content_rect.ax, item_ay, content_rect.bx, item_by, {radius = state.radius, color = fg, opacity = 0.1 * menu_opacity, clip = item_clip})
				elseif self.mouse_hovered_index == index then
					local ly = index < self.reorder.from and item_ay or (item_ay + self.scroll_step - self.separator_size)
					local lax, lbx = content_rect.ax + self.item_padding, content_rect.bx - self.item_padding
					ass:rect(lax, ly - 1.5 * sc, lbx, ly + 1.5 * sc, {color = fg, radius = 1.5 * sc, opacity = menu_opacity, clip = item_clip})
